hero.label: 2002 Legendary Collection Gastly Reverse Foil, #76 of 110, PSA 10. Seller received.

notes: PSA has graded 706 of this card. 18 are PSA 10, a 2.5% gem rate.
Legendary Collection (2002) was the last Wizards of the Coast set and the first English set with a reverse holo on every card. Its starburst foil appears nowhere else.
That foil scratches and whitens easily, which is why a common Gastly clears at five figures in a 10.
